# التمهيد — YT-Summarizer AI

> AI-powered YouTube video summarizer. Converts any YouTube video into structured Arabic academic summaries with export to PDF, Word, Markdown, and Notion.

## What This App Does

التمهيد (Al-Tamheed) is an Arabic-first AI summarization platform built for students, researchers, and content creators. It:

- Accepts any YouTube video URL (including Shorts, Live streams, and Embeds)
- Extracts the transcript using YouTube's official API
- Summarizes the content using Google Gemini AI with academic formatting
- Supports Arabic and English language summaries
- Exports to PDF, Word (.docx), Markdown, and Notion
- Offers a Telegram bot for instant mobile summarization
- Provides a community feed of public summaries

## Key Pages & Features

- **Home Page** (`/`): Main summarizer interface — paste a YouTube URL, select language, and generate an AI summary
- **Summary Viewer**: Full summary display with export buttons (PDF, Word, Markdown, Notion)
- **Community Feed**: Browse public summaries from other users
- **Settings Panel**: Configure custom Gemini API key, Notion integration, and Telegram account linking

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4
- Backend: Node.js + Express (deployed on Render)
- AI: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash
- Database: Firebase Firestore (named database)
- Auth: Firebase Authentication (Google Sign-In)
- Bot: Telegram Bot with inline keyboards
- Hosting: Vercel (frontend) + Render (backend/bot)

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/process-video` — Submit a YouTube URL for AI summarization
- `GET /api/summary/:id` — Fetch a saved summary by ID
- `GET /api/export-file?id=&format=` — Export summary as PDF/Word/Markdown
- `GET /api/health` — Server health check
